# What EpiExposure does?

`Introduzir o usuário ao workflow básico: da exposição ao modelo.`

```{r, eval = FALSE}
# =========================================================
# SIMULACAO: 520 epidemias x 86 dias
# 1 severidade por epidemia (DLNM-style)
# =========================================================

set.seed(123)

# -----------------------------
# Dimensoes
# -----------------------------
n_epi  <- 520
n_days <- 86   # 0–85

# -----------------------------
# Estrutura base (long format)
# -----------------------------
sim_data <- expand.grid(
  epi_id = 1:n_epi,
  dpp    = 0:(n_days - 1)
)

sim_data <- sim_data[order(sim_data$epi_id, sim_data$dpp), ]

# -----------------------------
# Inicializar
# -----------------------------
sim_data$tmean <- NA
sim_data$rain  <- NA
sim_data$rh    <- NA

# vetor final de severidade (1 por epi)
y_epi <- numeric(n_epi)

# =========================================================
# LOOP POR EPIDEMIA
# =========================================================

for (i in 1:n_epi) {

  idx <- sim_data$epi_id == i
  t_seq <- 0:(n_days - 1)

  # -----------------------------
  # Clima
  # -----------------------------
  tmean <- 25 + 5*sin(2*pi*t_seq/85) + rnorm(n_days, 0, 1.5)
  rh    <- 70 + 10*sin(2*pi*t_seq/85 + 1) + rnorm(n_days, 0, 4)
  rain  <- rpois(n_days, lambda = 3)

  # -----------------------------
  # ESTRUTURA DE LAG (CHAVE)
  # -----------------------------

  # efeito temperatura: forte em lags 5–20
  w_temp <- dnorm(t_seq, mean = 12, sd = 6)

  temp_effect <- sum(
    dnorm(tmean, mean = 25, sd = 4) * w_temp
  )

  # efeito chuva: acumulado em lags 10–30
  w_rain <- dnorm(t_seq, mean = 20, sd = 8)

  rain_effect <- sum(rain * w_rain)

  # efeito umidade: mais difuso
  w_rh <- dnorm(t_seq, mean = 15, sd = 10)

  rh_effect <- sum((rh - 60)/40 * w_rh)

  # -----------------------------
  # COMBINACAO FINAL (linear predictor)
  # -----------------------------
  eta <- 
    0.6 * temp_effect +
    0.2 * rain_effect +
    0.2 * rh_effect

  # -----------------------------
  # Converter para proporção (logit)
  # -----------------------------
  y_val <- 1 / (1 + exp(-eta/10 + rnorm(1, 0, 0.3)))

  # limitar
  y_val <- max(min(y_val, 0.95), 0.001)

  # -----------------------------
  # salvar
  # -----------------------------
  sim_data$tmean[idx] <- tmean
  sim_data$rain[idx]  <- rain
  sim_data$rh[idx]    <- rh

  y_epi[i] <- y_val
}

# =========================================================
# JUNTAR SEVERIDADE (1 por epi)
# =========================================================

y_df <- data.frame(
  epi_id = 1:n_epi,
  y = y_epi
)

sim_data <- merge(sim_data, y_df, by = "epi_id")

# ordenar novamente
sim_data <- sim_data[order(sim_data$epi_id, sim_data$dpp), ]

# =========================================================
# RESULTADO
# =========================================================

head(sim_data)

# checagem
table(table(sim_data$epi_id))   # deve dar 86 por epi
length(unique(sim_data$epi_id)) # 520 epidemias
```
```{r}
library(EpiExposure)
```

```{r}
sim_data
```


```{r}

sim_data = sim_data %>%
  group_by(epi_id) %>% 
  mutate(
    cum = cumsum(rain)
  )

rh_plot = sim_data%>% 
  ggplot(aes(dpp,tmean, group = epi_id))+
  geom_smooth(se = F, color = "darkgreen",linewidth = 0.3)+
  theme_bw()+
  labs(x = "Days before the assessement",
       y = "")+
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0,85))
```

```{r, eval = FALSE}


cb <- define_exposure(
  wx_long = sim_data,
  vars = c("cum"),
  lag_max = 85,
  df_var = 2,
  df_lag = 5
)

```


```{r}

# construir design matrix
dat <- build_design(
  wx_long = sim_data,
  cb_templates = cb,
  lag_max = 85
)

```


```{r}

# preparar resposta
dat <- prepare_response(dat, y_var = "y", family = "beta")

```


```{r}



# ajustar modelo
fit <- fit_epidlnm(
  dat = dat,
  model_engine = "glmmTMB",
  family = "beta",
  random_effect = "epi_id",
  epiexposure_spec = attr(cb, "spec")
)


t = predict(fit, newdata = dat, type = "response")


dat2 = dat
dat2$t = t


dat2 %>% 
  ggplot(aes(y,t))+
  geom_point()



sim_dataa = sim_data %>% 
  filter(epi_id <= 80)

best <- find_bestfit(
  epi_data = sim_dataa,
  response = "y",
  group = "epi_id",
  time = "dpp",
  vars = c("tmean", "rh"),
  lag_max = 85,
  df_var_grid = c(2),
  df_lag_grid = c(2),
  max_vars = 2,
  model_engine = "glmmTMB",
  family = "beta",
  verbose = TRUE
)

sim_data

ens_unweighted <- ensemble_bestfit(
  bestfit = best,
  method = "unweighted",
  top_n = 10
)


ens_weighted <- ensemble_bestfit(
  bestfit = best,
  method = "weighted",
  top_n = 10,
  weight_metric = "CCC",
  weight_transform = "softmax"
)


ens_best <- ensemble_bestfit(
  bestfit = best,
  method = "hard_voting",
  top_n = 10
)


ens_stacked <- ensemble_bestfit(
  bestfit = best,
  method = "stacked",
  top_n = 10,
  stacking_model = "ridge",
  lambda = 1e-4
)
```

```{r}
sim_temp <- simulate_exposure(
  lag_max = 85,
  mode = "pattern",
  pattern = "alternating_lags",
  alternating_values = c(25, 30),
  background = list(dist = "fixed", value = 0)
)

sim_rain <- simulate_exposure(
  lag_max = 85,
  mode = "pattern",
  pattern = "block_lags",
  block_lags = c(10, 30),
  fixed_value = 10,
  background = list(dist = "fixed", value = 0)
)

sim_humidity <- simulate_exposure(
  lag_max = 85,
  mode = "profile",
  background = list(dist = "normal", mean = 90, sd = 5)
)

```

```{r}
pred <- predict_outcome(
  fit = fit,
  profiles = list(
    tmean = sim_temp$profile,
    rain = sim_rain$profile,
    rh = sim_humidity$profile
  )
)

```

```{r}
best <- find_bestfit(
  epi_data = sim_dataa,
  response = "y",

attr(best, "predictions")
```
```{r}
ens <- ensemble_bestfit(
  bestfit = best,
  ensemble_scope = "lag",
  epi_data = sim_dataa,
  group = "epi_id",
  var = c("tmean", "rain"),
  reverse = TRUE
)

ens$ensemble_by_lag

```

```{r}
best_model_id <- best$model_id[1]
best_model_id

best_lag <- ens$lag_data |>
  dplyr::filter(model_id == best_model_id)
```

```{r}
ensemble_lag <- ens$ensemble_by_lag
```

```{r}
best_model_id <- best$model_id[1]

best_lag <- ens$lag_data |>
  dplyr::filter(model_id == best_model_id) |>
  dplyr::select(
    var,
    lag,
    best_model_contribution = contribution
  )

ensemble_lag <- ens$ensemble_by_lag |>
  dplyr::select(
    var,
    lag,
    ensemble_contribution,
    ensemble_percent_contribution
  )

lag_compare <- dplyr::left_join(
  best_lag,
  ensemble_lag,
  by = c("var", "lag")
)

lag_compare
```

```{r}
lag_compare <- lag_compare |>
  dplyr::group_by(var) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    best_model_percent_contribution =
      100 * abs(best_model_contribution) /
      sum(abs(best_model_contribution), na.rm = TRUE)
  ) |>
  dplyr::ungroup()
```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyr)
library(dplyr)

plot_df <- lag_compare |>
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    cols = c(best_model_contribution, ensemble_contribution),
    names_to = "source",
    values_to = "contribution"
  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    source = dplyr::recode(
      source,
      best_model_contribution = "Best model",
      ensemble_contribution = "Lag ensemble"
    )
  )

ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = lag, y = contribution, color = source)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  facet_wrap(~ var, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(
    x = "Lag",
    y = "Lag-specific contribution",
    color = NULL,
    title = "Lag-specific contribution: best model vs lag ensemble"
  ) +
  theme_bw()
```

```{r}
plot_pct <- lag_compare |>
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    cols = c(best_model_percent_contribution, ensemble_percent_contribution),
    names_to = "source",
    values_to = "percent_contribution"
  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    source = dplyr::recode(
      source,
      best_model_percent_contribution = "Best model",
      ensemble_percent_contribution = "Lag ensemble"
    )
  )

ggplot(plot_pct, aes(x = lag, y = percent_contribution, color = source)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  facet_wrap(~ var, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(
    x = "Lag",
    y = "Relative contribution (%)",
    color = NULL,
    title = "Relative lag importance: best model vs lag ensemble"
  ) +
  theme_bw()
```

```{r}
lag_distance <- lag_compare |>
  dplyr::group_by(var) |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    rmse_contribution = sqrt(mean(
      (best_model_contribution - ensemble_contribution)^2,
      na.rm = TRUE
    )),
    correlation = stats::cor(
      best_model_contribution,
      ensemble_contribution,
      use = "complete.obs"
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

lag_distance
```
```{r}
lag_compare |>
  dplyr::filter(var == "rain") |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    min_best = min(best_model_contribution, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_best = max(best_model_contribution, na.rm = TRUE),
    min_ensemble = min(ensemble_contribution, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_ensemble = max(ensemble_contribution, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_abs_best = mean(abs(best_model_contribution), na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_abs_ensemble = mean(abs(ensemble_contribution), na.rm = TRUE),
    rmse_relative_to_best =
      sqrt(mean((best_model_contribution - ensemble_contribution)^2, na.rm = TRUE)) /
      mean(abs(best_model_contribution), na.rm = TRUE)
  )
```
